description: Zero-shot transfer of source-grouped Rs-QLoRA r64 adapters to external human-vs-LLM review corpora; threshold 0.5; mean and sample SD over training seeds 1998, 7, 42.

dataset_manifest.normalization: HTML tags and leading template labels removed, then build_modern_dataset.normalize_text (both classes)

maideup_en.selection: all English rows; text = Upside_Review + ' ' + Downside_Review

excluded_domains.Hotel: human TripAdvisor text is lowercased with stop words removed (stop-word rate 0.009 vs 0.30-0.37 for generated text)

mage_yelp.selection: all Yelp rows of the MAGE test split (continuation prompts)
